# Agent Instructions

This project is an ASP.NET Minimal API integration component using Dapr pub/sub with the in-memory component. It exposes `POST /publish`, and the subscribed endpoint runs the order send pipeline, writing the result to a local storage binding.

## Project overview

- Framework: .NET 10
- App type: ASP.NET Core Minimal API
- Dapr package: `Dapr.AspNetCore`
- App id: `int123`
- App port: `5001`
- Pub/sub component: `pubsub` (in-memory)
- Topic: `messages`
- Output binding: `local-storage` (Dapr local storage, rootPath `./local/test/out`)

## Important files

- `src/Program.cs` - DI wiring and framework registration.
- `src/Configuration/Constants.cs` - component, topic, and binding names.
- `src/Ingest/Endpoints.cs` - HTTP endpoints and the Dapr subscription.
- `src/Process/` - the order send pipeline, its builder, and step classes.
- `local/dapr-components/` - local Dapr component YAMLs (pub/sub, storage binding).
- `Dockerfile` - multi-stage image build on the .NET chiseled ASP.NET runtime,
  listening on port 5001 (`docker build -t int123 .`); the image contains
  only the app — the Dapr sidecar and components come from the deployment
  environment.
- `src/INT123.http` - sample HTTP requests.

## Build and run

Build:

```bash
dotnet build ./src
```

Run with Dapr:

dapr run \

===INT123 README===
# INT123

ASP.NET Minimal API sample that publishes a message with Dapr pub/sub and receives it through a subscribed endpoint.

## Run

```bash
dapr run \
  --app-id int123 \
  --app-port 5001 \
  --dapr-http-port 3500 \
  --resources-path ./local/dapr-components \
  -- dotnet run --project ./src --urls http://localhost:5001
```

## Endpoints

- `POST /publish` - the public route you call; accepts an `OrderIn` (`{ "orderId": "...", "customerId": "...", "amount": 0 }`) and publishes it to Dapr pub/sub component `pubsub`, topic `messages`.
- `POST /subscribe` - not a route you call; subscribed to `pubsub/messages`, Dapr invokes it for each message and runs it through the send pipeline.
- `GET /dapr/subscribe` - generated by Dapr.AspNetCore to expose subscriptions to the Dapr sidecar.

Use `src/INT123.http` to send a sample request.

## Container image

```bash
docker build -t int123 .
```

name: maxbo-product-distribution

include:
  - path: ./platform-services/compose.yaml

services:
  extractor-perfion:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: extractor/perfion/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "5038:8080"
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_URLS: "http://+:8080"
      DAPR_HTTP_PORT: "3500"
      DAPR_GRPC_PORT: "50001"
      OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: "http://lgtm:4317"
      PlatformServices__IdempotencyServiceAppId: "iss-idempotency-service"
      PlatformServices__BusinessIncidentServiceAppId: "bis-business-incident-service"
    depends_on:
      idempotency-service:
        condition: service_started
      idempotency-dapr:
        condition: service_started

  extractor-perfion-dapr:
    image: daprio/daprd:1.16.1
    command: [
      "./daprd",
      "-app-id", "extractor-perfion-app",
      "-app-port", "8080",
      "-dapr-http-port", "3500",
      "-dapr-grpc-port", "50001",
      "-resources-path", "/components",
      "-config", "/components/config.yaml",
      "-log-level", "debug"
    ]
    volumes:
      - ./shared-dapr-components:/components
    network_mode: "service:extractor-perfion"
    depends_on:
      idempotency-service:
        condition: service_started
      idempotency-dapr:
        condition: service_started
      extractor-perfion:
        condition: service_started
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:4.0.2-management
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD", "rabbitmqctl", "status" ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
